create.name: Carole Westerman
create.bio:
Carole Westerman is a yoga and meditation teacher based in Omaha, Nebraska, whose classes lean towards the slow end of practice: yin, restorative yoga, yoga nidra and quiet breathing. She came to yoga through Hatha and Kundalini, spent years in the Iyengar style and later taught vinyasa, before an injury turned her towards stillness and the softer forms she is now known for. She studied psychology to master's level, has travelled to India four times to study yoga, meditation and philosophy, and is registered with Yoga Alliance at the 500-hour level. Among the teachers she credits are Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Tara Brach and Judith Lasater.

Her sessions combine gentle postures with meditation, breath practice, journaling and, at times, aromatherapy, with the aim of helping people slow down and rest while awake. Alongside group classes she trains yoga teachers, works as a leadership and wellbeing coach at an integrative clinic in Omaha, and leads retreats abroad, with past groups in India, Bali, Greece and Peru. Some of her classes appear on Yoga International and Glo, and longer yin and restorative sessions are free on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: The Art of Deep Rest
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York, built around rest as a daily practice rather than something left to the night. Sessions move through gentle yoga, yoga nidra, meditation, breathing, aromatherapy, journaling and group conversation, starting simple and building over the week. No yoga experience is needed.

courses.title: Retreat in the Sacred Valley, Peru
courses.description: A week-long retreat with Carole at Willka T'ika in Peru's Sacred Valley, combining yoga, mindfulness and time in nature with a small group. Details and booking are by enquiry.

courses.title: Coaching with Carole
courses.description: One-to-one coaching that draws on mindfulness, breath practice, embodiment work and coaching frameworks, aimed at self-awareness and steadier ways of working and living. Sessions are shaped around each client's goals.
